lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense cluster of high-intensity circular spots arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits and dorsal to the pectoral fin. Major centroids form approximately parallel rows with vertical alignment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal linear arrangements of spots, particularly prominent in the mid-flank region where spots serve as high-contrast nodes within a faint grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light on the dorsal edge to a darker shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A digital watermark/logo containing the text 'Village Dive' is present in the upper right quadrant, occluding a portion of the shark's posterior-dorsal surface.
